nodes.description: Ownable.owner - privileged address that can transfer ownership and call onlyOwner functions
Ownable.admin - secondary privileged address usable by onlyOwnerOrAdmin
BasicToken.balances mapping address to token balance
BasicToken._totalSupply total minted token supply
ERC20Token.allowed nested mapping owner=>spender=>allowance
TokenLock.lockingStates mapping address to TokenLockState holding lock array and latest release time
TokenLock.addresslock per-address transfer lock flag
TokenLock.lockbalances per-address permanently locked volume
TokenLock.transferEnabled global switch enabling transfers
TokenLock.noTokenLocked flag that releases all token locks
DRE.TOTAL_SUPPLY constant 9000000000 * 10**18
DetailedERC20.decimals token decimals value
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner - moves owner pointer to newOwner
Ownable.setAdmin(address) onlyOwner - assigns the admin state variable
DRE.setAdmin(address) onlyOwner - overrides setAdmin and grants allowance to the new admin
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256) - moves balances using SafeMath
DRE.transfer(address,uint256) - transfer with onlyValidDestination and canTransfer modifiers
DRE.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) - delegated transfer updating balances and allowance
BurnableToken.burn(uint256) onlyOwner - reduces caller balance and total supply
ERC20Token.approve(address,uint256) - sets allowance requiring zero-current or zero-value
ERC20Token.increaseApproval(address,uint256) - SafeMath add to allowance
ERC20Token.decreaseApproval(address,uint256) - SafeMath sub from allowance
TokenLock.unlockAllTokens() onlyOwner - sets noTokenLocked to true globally
TokenLock.enableTransfer(bool) onlyOwner - toggles the transferEnabled switch
TokenLock.getMinLockedAmount(address) view - sums locked amounts still in the future using block timestamps
TokenLock.lockVolumeAddress(address) view - returns lockbalances entry
TokenLock.addTokenLockDate(address,uint256,uint256) onlyOwnerOrAdmin - pushes time based lock entries
TokenLock.addTokenLock(address,uint256) onlyOwnerOrAdmin - writes lockbalances for an address
TokenLock.addressLockTransfer(address,bool) onlyOwner - toggles per-address transfer lock
DRE.canTransferIfLocked(address,uint256) view - checks remaining balance covers locked volume
DRE.LockTransferAddress(address) view - returns addresslock flag for an address
DRE constructor - sets total supply and mints all tokens to owner
DRE fallback payable function that always reverts
BasicToken.balanceOf(address) view - reads balances mapping
msg.sender - caller controlled address used for authorization and balance bookkeeping
block.timestamp (now) - miner influenced time used for lock calculations
Write of the owner state variable in Ownable constructor and transferOwnership
DRE.setAdmin approves TOTAL_SUPPLY allowance to the newly appointed admin
addTokenLockDate requires _release_time > now, a timestamp dependent access check
getMinLockedAmount compares stored lock times against now to compute locked amount
DRE.transferFrom subtracts from balances[_from] and allowance before crediting
balances[_sender].sub(_value) arithmetic inside canTransferIfLocked
DRE fallback reverts on direct ETH transfers
BurnableToken.burn subtracts from balances[msg.sender] and _totalSupply
_to destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom
_value amount parameter used across transfer/approve/burn
_from source address parameter of transferFrom
_spender address parameter of approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval
_addr target address parameter of the TokenLock lock functions
_release_time unix timestamp parameter of addTokenLockDate
_enable boolean parameter of enableTransfer/addressLockTransfer
newOwner address parameter of transferOwnership
newAdmin address parameter of setAdmin functions
_sender address parameter of canTransferIfLocked
lockState storage pointer to the caller address TokenLockState
lockSum accumulator of future locked amounts in getMinLockedAmount
_owner address parameter of balanceOf/allowance
after_math result of balances[_sender].sub(_value) in canTransferIfLocked

normalization_plan.reason: the _to parameter only flows into BasicToken.transfer and carries no independent security semantics
the _value parameter is the amount consumed by transfer logic and is normalized into it
the _from parameter is only the debited account of transferFrom
the _spender parameter is only the allowance target of approve
the _addr parameter only selects the lockingStates entry in addTokenLockDate
the _release_time parameter is only meaningful as the time based lock input
the _enable parameter only toggles the transferEnabled switch
newOwner exists only to be written into the owner state variable
newAdmin exists only to be granted the TOTAL_SUPPLY allowance
the _sender parameter is only used to compute the subtractive lock check
the lockState local is only a storage alias used inside getMinLockedAmount
the lockSum local is only the accumulator result of getMinLockedAmount
the _owner parameter is only a lookup key for balanceOf/allowance
the after_math local is only the intermediate subtraction result of canTransferIfLocked
